snippet.title: SuperLite 1500 Series: Crazy Balloon 2000 (PlayStation)
snippet.description: Another Taito Classic in the SuperLite 1500 Series, this time it's Crazy Balloon, which still gives me anxiety. Of course it comes with Original and Arrangement modes. I wish I had known about this version sooner, but the next video will be back to your regularly scheduled content.
